cases.name: Forbidden Ritual
cases.text: Sacrifice a nontoken permanent. If you do, target opponent loses 2 life unless that player sacrifices a permanent of their choice or discards a card. You may repeat this process any number of times.

cases.name: Quiet Omen
cases.text: Sacrifice a nontoken permanent. If you do, target opponent loses 3 life unless that player sacrifices a permanent of their choice or discards a card. You may repeat this process any number of times.

cases.name: Silent Pact
cases.text: Sacrifice a nontoken permanent. If you do, target opponent loses 2 life unless that player sacrifices a permanent of their choice or discards two cards. You may repeat this process any number of times.
